build_LatentLayersKLLoss: build a LatentLayersKLLoss module to compute KL divergence loss with uniform or aggregated posterior prior
run_LatentLayersKLLoss_forward: run the LatentLayersKLLoss forward pass with layer samples, language index, update number, and sample size
build_LatentLayersSparsityLoss: build a LatentLayersSparsityLoss module to compute sparsity and sharing loss across latent layers
run_LatentLayersSparsityLoss_forward: run the LatentLayersSparsityLoss forward pass to compute batch loss with layer utilization and target layers
review_LatentLayersSparsityLoss_is_valid: review the LatentLayersSparsityLoss is_valid method to check if sparsity loss should be applied at current update
